Three hours later, the shah now sat in another boardroom with the 21 senators and Edis, the senate had requested a hearing on the plans for the Alaqar matter and what the Shahs opinion and intentions were should the referendum result in a vote to go to war against Alaqar.
Gentlemen, I am sure you are all aware of the state of our armed forces, and I am sure you are aware of the state of the armed forces of Alaqar, began the shah.
The senators nodded.
Given the data and the facts of the matter, it makes no sense that we should pursue this war, and I move to invoke the Presidential Veto Act, which will stop the referendum in its tracks, and prevent potential disaster,
A low chuckle ran around the room, one of the Senators stood up and said, With all due respect sir, the invocation of that act requires approval from the lower chamber, elongating the process, and the legislative mandate is clearthe femboy issue must be dealt with decisively, said the senator smacking the table with an open palm.
There are other ways than a war powers resolution, intoned the Shah.
Edis coughed.
Sir with all due respect, what other ways are there, do you want Wuloosya to embargo them alongside you? Laughed one of the Senators.
Edis coughed again. The shah looked at him with a frown before stating, Do not worry, I have a plan to ensure the stability of this country before ideology,
But this country is built on ideology! Boomed a loud jiggling voice, causing the senators to turn in their seats to face where the voice came from, it turned out to be the massive, wheezing, sweaty form of Cahit Alparslan rolling through the double doors of the room, in his hand, a gyro sat perched between his fingers like a diamond.
You were not invited to this meeting, stated Edis flipping through the list of attendees to double check.
Do not worry my dear friend Edis, I am merely exercising my right to ensure that this senate understands what is at stake here, Cahit leaned forward munching on the gyro, the wheelchair creaking.
I was speaking with the Generalissimo the reverent and honourable, Turgut Reis, who bless him, weighs many more shekels than I! Intoned Cahit with reverence.
Peace be to him, said some senators with appreciative bows of their head as the shah quietly put his hand to his face.
And you know what the honorable Generalissimo said to me, peace be on him, he said that he was sad to see the state of our armed forces, the soldiers are fat, the youth are not enlisting, and the horses the horses of the glorious steppes are not being used! Declared Cahit, taking another bite of his gyro.
How is this relevant, Cahit? Asked the shah.
Cahit held up his pointer finger with noble air and declared, Hear me my countrymen, citizens of this republic, strength is paramount to our glory, our heritage, our safety! He finished the gyro and laid his non elevated hand on the table, The mullahs did not ask for war, they asked for strength,
And peace be to the mullahs, declared another senator.
Cahit stared sternly at this man his jowls jiggling, Peace be to the Ayatollah,
The other senators echoed the peace to the Ayatollah.
So if you will permit my suggestion, your honour, intoned Cahit.
Go ahead, sighed the shah.
Take this war bill, and use its momentum to expand our forces! Clapped Cahit.
Expand our factories, lower the debt, seek out morestable allies! He continued, clapping as the other senators clapped.

[b]Hell rains down: A multifront war[/b]
The SCSID had already been watching the movements of the forces in Corzerran, and Wuloosya by both the HDF and Wuloosyan defense forces, it had already been ascertained a day after the initial strikes in March 8 and 9 that there were plans to potentially launch a heavy front loaded attack on the nation via the utilisation of missiles and necessary equipment for such an attack.
It was thus that the SCSID would immediately order evacuations on the evening of March the 9th of the relevant command staff and the triumvirate to specialised non-public bunkers across the country, particularly Area-6 (Montfleur-Rosenmarkke border), Area-10 (Rosenmarkket Mountains), and Area-5 (Central Rosenmarkke 154 km from capital) creating a multilayered dispersal of the command structure with Strømm and the central SCSID command splitting. 
In the meantime Strømm would sign an emergency military command order, summoning the council of 99 to assemble in Vespurias in order to formally govern the country while Strømm would order the creation of a Unified White Sea Command and a Northern Command. 
Following this all military communication channels would be moved to the third layer communication backchannels which would be routed via hardened fiber networks. In order to eliminate potential vulnerabilities regarding satellite and satellite communications the SCSID would order the activation of the nations vast analog network, which while less reliable would provide a secure communications and support network should satellites be affected.
Under orders of the SCSID the army would maintain the blinking doctrine it had instated on the night of the first attack, using randomised blinking and moving patterns to avoid anti-radiation missiles.
While the ALBM missiles would strike the National House and the SCSID headquarters at Jules Viernes Place, lamentably killing three elderly janitors and a street dog, the others would strike empty bunkers due to the nation's multi-layered bunker system, although a minor strike would strike the entrance to the deep underground bunker of Area-5, killing 1 soldier and injuring another. The rest would be fired upon by the S-400 SAM, S-300 SAM, and attempts would be made by the NASAMs and IRIS-TLs to intercept the others, all under the specialised changing blinking emissions plan.
It would be no less than a few minutes after the ALBM missiles that the HDF had deployed their suppression tactics, orders would immediately go out for the deployment of six AEW&C aircraft to begin sensing operations, followed by a wing of F-35s moving into place to establish defensive combat air patrols in key strategic regions with the Mig-29 and Su-30s moving to provide back up support.
The SAM systems would primarily fire at the crucial aircraft of the HDF, including jamming platforms and bomber formations.
To counter SEAD efforts by the HDF, the radars and SAM systems acquainted with them would shift and shut off, with decoy radars taking off.
Unfortunately, due to the large number of cruise missiles, damage would be incurred against air force bases across the country; however, no major loss of operations would be achieved.
It would be at this time that eyes would move towards the beginnings of operation Wailord, which had begun its early stages. Unfortunately, a crucial component regarding the Drawing out of the Navy.  had been overestimated, with the Rosenmarkke navy having just returned from its global circumnavigation. As the initial phases of Wailord would begin the SCSID would order all ships immediately to begin protective maneuvers within the SAM system ordering major frigates and other such ships to shift ports, silence comms and radar, and constantly move within a designated pre-planned cover area. GPS jammers would be deployed around the major naval and land bases. In the meantime, false ship signatures would be deployed to confuse Wuloosyan dependence on radar technology.
Unfortunately due to the short span of time and decreased coastal jamming capacity, major strikes would be made against the naval assets, sinking 10 frigates, and 4 destroyers. With 1 of the CATOBAR carriers being brought out of commission by two strikes.
To address the plan to destroy the bases which were already being partially bombarded by missiles, the planes of the Rosenmarkket air force had also entered into a decentralised command model with each pilot being directed by the SCSID to Do with the plane as necessary to secure the state. As a result, major bases and the large trophy bases would be primarily emptied of their planes before the attack and in the early hours of the operation.
In the meantime, the three submarines within the White Sea would adopt a strict radio, deep water patrol doctrine, with the subs moving to reduce all traceable signals from the superior Wuloosyan hunters. The subs would also use a randomised movement route, which would push the Wuloosyan subs into containment zones while subs that were not necessarily tracked would launch attacks on the tracking subs. In the meantime, two subs would move to target the Wuloosyan ISR ships and systems in the White Sea, primarily the Emrik Broadmoore.
While the strikes against the naval infrastructure would be moderately successful in their hits, with various fuel depots and logistical hubs being damaged or destroyed, Rosenmarkke would not see full operational degradation.
As the smoke continued to flow into the air from the fog of war, the council of 99 would release a public announcement from Vespurias, cited as: 

It is with great sorrow that we announce the death of the highest levels of the government and of the SCSID, who sacrificed their lives to defend our great nation. This stands as the greatest tragedy in modern Rosenmarkket history, and we, the Council of 99, promise to take all actions to avenge their deaths, glory to Rosenmarkke,
Following this announcement, SCSID hackers and private hacking companies within Rosenmarkke would begin the nations first mass hacking attack against Wuloosya, attempting to hit critical government infrastructure (except for hospitals and civilian based infrastructure critical for survival), including banking, armed forces intel, sattelite controls, and wider government communications in order to disrupt, distort, and potentially destroy Wuloosyan security and military infrastructure capabilities, relying on the Wuloosyans heavy usage of technology to weaken their homefront distance advantage. 
At the same time, a group of private hackers not formally associated with official SCSID or hacking companies in Rosenmarkke would hack into the Wuloosyan national television and radio networks to relay videos of Polenne Strømm with the words, You killed our motherbut the phoenix always is reborn, 
Following the hacking attempts, Rosenmarkke would launch 14 non-nuclear SRBMs at Wuloosyan craft in the White Sea, 20 MRBMs at the Wuloosyan coastline, aiming to strike military installations and major ports. At the same time wide range of GPS and intel spoofing efforts would begin with Rosenmarkke itself, beginning the transition to third lane networks embedded deep into the network infrastructure of Rosenmarkke as well as analog systems. 

In the meantime, mourners and supporters of Polenne Strømm would fill the streets, heading towards the burnt-out National House, which had been struck by one of the missiles, to hear eulogies and songs about the former dictator of Rosenmarkke; these would be televised to an international audience. Although some skeptics of the whole affair would state that no formal autopsy or report of bodies being found had been given out, supporters of the regime would simply dismiss this as the SCSID protecting the desecration of the bodies of the leadership. 
Overall, the combined attacks of the HDF and WDF would cause widespread damage to air bases, naval ports, and monumental infrastructure; however, the initial objectives of Wailord and Crusader (to draw out the navy and eliminate it, and to decapitate the state leadership) would be only partially achieved.
